review_description: Great system. No nonsense, explained details well, followed up at every stage. Would recommend to anyone

I am very happy with the installation of solar panels and a battery by LV Renewables.  The complete procedure from quoting for the system, to installation of the system, to customer service was managed professionally and punctually.  LV Renewables organised both the grid connection and installation of an iPhone app that allows me to monitor the efficiency of the solar system.

The quoting process with Sean was great and very knowledgeable. Provided several options and answered all my questions. The in-house installer Tyler came onsite to check location before quote finalisation.Sean was great with communication with unexpected delays as our install got caught up with supply issues because EOF the new battery rebate.Unfortunately I had specifically requested a few panels on west side and on the day they were not installed & instead added to our east string (due to not being enough voltage to trigger the string), Tyler did not mention it during install and I only noticed when I looked at the roof the next day.  This was our only disappointment in regards to communications, we were shown voltage results on why west string wasn't viable so it was really just a limitation with the system.Took an extra visit to get the monitoring working correctly, but it was a quick & simple.
LV Renewables were great to deal with  gave a very competitive price on best gear . Kept informed throughout, installers did a great job and left everything tidy.Highly recommend
Great service very helpful explained all aspects of the installation
Good communication,  knowledgeable and helpful, very happy with the service.

I found the company very helpful in getting the right system that suited me.The only company out of five that went onto the roof to check for solar panel layout rather then relying on satellite imagery.I met the boys on the install and found them very pleasant and  informative, answering my questions was not a problem.Now the system is up and running I couldn’t be happier with the outcome.

The whole process was a painless experience from the initial quote & explanation of the process to the agreed installation date, the install team where actually waiting out the front of my premises & ready to go at 7am, the agreed time. I could not fault them, very efficient & polite along with a quality job I couldn't have asked for anything more!

LV Renewables were thoroughly professional, responsive and accommodating. The other two companies who were supposedly supplying quotes didn’t, so I went with LV Renewables basically because they wanted my business. Based on some internet research and discussion with friends who have solar systems I believed the quote I received was competitive and the service I received from LV Renewables was faultless. Would definitely recommend to others. Thanks Sean and Tyler and Gary

I was very happy with the explanation for the solar system design, which was appropriate for our energy needs, and the reasons for the choice of hardware. They also understood my desire for the system to be sympathetic with the architecture of the house.Their website literature and downloadable documentation were very useful and not overly technical or complicated..Their installation went smoothly, and I was pleased with how easily they communicated with me and my questions. Also  the availability of follow-up services and maintenance was appreciated.Overall, my "solar project", from scoping to installation and commissioning was much less daunting than I initially thought.Thankyou RV Renewables.

The quoting experience was pleasant and did exactly what I wanted, didn't talk me into anything whilst providing good advice. They turned up when they said they would and did installation in a day. They even noticed some broken tiles on the roof that had nothing to do with them and replaced them.Oranised a new meter too and provided clear communication throughout this process.

LV were extremely knowledgeable and helpful during the quoting process. The install was carried out with professionalism, in a timely manner using experienced trades.Neat, tidy, no fuss and no bother.  We are extremely happy with our system, LV and our outcome.  Highly recommend using SolarQuotes and LV Renewables.

Quote was done by on site tradesman that was also the install, didn't try and up sell or pressure anything just laid out the options nicely.Installation was quick and faultless, on time with booking and don't in the two days quoted.Customer service by the company was faultless, they were fast at responding to emails, willing to chat on the phone and also a breeze to deal with.

Salesperson was knowledgeable, polite and, most importantly, patient. I had lots of questions and lots of deliberation time to get my head around the heavy investment I was about to make and the representative was accommodating.I was delivered hardware options and a background on the companies and their performance, and then helpful and concise answers to my many questions.The installation was clean, the site was left tidy afterwards and the installers helped me set up the inverter to my network and was shown how the system functions within the app.The original salesperson also assisted me with the application to get tariffs added to my existing plan.I've had no issues with the installation of the system that I've noted yet, and I will be going with the same company when I decide to get a battery installed later in the year.
Sales was great quote was goodi installers were quick and polite easy to get on with

I installed the Goldilocks system not to cheap not to expensiveThe installer answered all questions and took the time to visit site twice to ensure we could install the optimal system for my situation (having to work around a hot water panel on limited roof space)This resulted in not just an optimal but very clean/tidy install.Well done LV renewables

Quoting process was smooth. I did not consider the one installation company that did not attend my property. The other two provided competitive quotes with high quality systems and their reps were both very knowledgeable and easy to deal with. The decision was extremely close. I chose LV Renewables on the basis of the quote, as the panels and inverter were of a similar quality. Installation by LV was very timely and post installation service has been excellent. We have deferred a decision on a battery for around 12 months to determine exactly what our requirements are.
